prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
For most small businesses, **Otterly.AI** is a practical place to start: it’s designed for lightweight monitoring, lets you track prompts you care about, and reports whether your business appears in answers from ChatGPT and other AI search tools. Its entry plan is reported at roughly **$25–$29/month**, depending on billing and current plan details.

If you want a broader SEO and competitor-research suite, **Semrush AI Visibility** is a more full-featured option, but it’s around **$99/month per domain** and may be more than you need just to check recommendations.

Whichever you choose, track realistic questions customers might ask—such as “best [service] in [city]”—and review the actual answers and sources, not just a visibility score. AI answers can vary by prompt, location, and time, so treat any tracker as a useful sample rather than a definitive ranking.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
